trial_hooks: Banned decades after he said it
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau said these things decades ago and was crucified for them.

He called talcum powder 'poisonous' long before Johnson's Baby Powder left store shelves and the FDA began pulling it from food.

He warned that fluoride in drinking water could lower thyroid function. Today, fluoridated water is banned across most of the world.

Red dye No. 3? Removed from the U.S. food supply this year - the same dye he was warning about back then.

Three warnings people called crazy. Three outcomes that matched. What is he saying now that nobody's listening to yet?

clips.send: A shopper sends this to a friend who swears by organic dressing: anger at paying extra for the same cheap oil.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says most 'organic' products are barely organic at all - and his own grocery story proves it.

Pick up a hundred bottles of organic Italian salad dressing. Almost none of them use olive oil. Instead: sunflower oil, canola oil, soybean oil, avocado oil - all labeled organic, none of it what a real Italian dressing is made with.

Kevin says the real ingredient is simply too expensive, so companies swap it and keep the organic label anyway.

Next time you flip an 'organic' bottle over, read past the front label. What's the first oil actually listed?

#kevintrudeau #organicfood #readthelabel #foodtruth #wbdaily #healthtruth

clips.end_words: what science do you even follow
clips.send: A parent sends this to another parent before buying a filter: anxiety over who's actually telling the truth about fluoride.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau points to one word everyone uses to settle an argument: science. But on fluoride, he says there isn't just one science - there are two.

In nearly every country except the U.S. and New Zealand, Kevin says the science concluded fluoride in drinking water is bad for your health - which is why courts and governments there banned it.

In America, the official science says the opposite: that drinking fluoridated water is fine.

Same element. Same water. Two completely opposite conclusions, both called 'the science.'

So which science do you actually follow?

#kevintrudeau #fluoride #waterfiltration #foodtruth #wbdaily #healthtruth

clips.send: A tired coworker sends this to the one drinking five coffees a day: the simple fix that actually clears brain fog.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says the real reason you crash in the afternoon isn't about caffeine - it's about what you're using as fuel.

He skips coffee as a stimulant and skips energy drinks entirely. His fuel, he says, is simply real food - the kind your body is actually built to run on.

And if you eat and still feel tired afterward? Kevin says that's usually a histamine issue, not a lack of willpower.

His bigger point: physical energy keeps your mind sharp. Lose it, and you get brain fog, lose focus, and everything else gets harder.

What do you reach for when your energy crashes?
